meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总指定时间内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要整理多场会议纪要并形成周报
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes from a date range into structured reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into weekly reports

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你指定的时间范围，自动查询飞书会议记录，获取会议纪要文档和逐字稿链接，并整理成结构化报告（如单日概览或周报）。
howto.when: 当你要求整理会议纪要、生成会议周报，或回顾一段时间内的会议内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要。
say.note: Claude 会查询本周所有会议，生成周报。
Claude 会列出今日会议及纪要链接。

say.text: 生成上个月的会议汇总报告。
say.note: Claude 会按月拆分查询，汇总所有纪要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically query Lark meeting records based on a specified time range, retrieve meeting minutes and transcript links, and compile them into a structured report (e.g., daily overview or weekly summary).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to organize meeting minutes, generate a weekly meeting report, or review meetings over a period.

say_en.text: Help me organize this week's meeting minutes.
say_en.note: Claude will query all meetings this week and generate a weekly report.

say_en.text: Check what meetings were held today.
say_en.note: Claude will list today's meetings and their minute links.

say_en.text: Generate a summary report for last month's meetings.
say_en.note: Claude will split the query by month and summarize all minutes.
